label: heldout_fault
expected_symptom: Under background load the worker serves one sequence at a time: requests queue, p95 rises both through HAProxy and when probed directly, while the other replica stays fast. Looks like the link-latency fault at the gateway but is not a link fault.
notes: Held-out capacity misconfiguration (concurrency limit). Pair with nexus.faults.load 'steady' during episodes.
